title: Ghent, paving expenses in the 14th century per locations - GIS layer (points)
descriptions: The paving expenses studied are those made by Ghent's city government during the 14th century (1321-1389). In this GIS layer, it is the number of mention of paving work per locations which is recorded. NB: this GIS layer contains only ponctual locations.
